thesis: The page is a torsion spring being wound: every section is one more quarter turn, and the repair isn't done until the count reaches 30 and the door holds itself halfway.

signature.name: Winding Count
signature.summary: A drawn torsion spring in the left margin that winds as you scroll with a mono quarter-turn counter (00/30); section edges are garage-door panel seams ending in a roller. Appears on the hero strip, the pinned 5-step repair story (each step lands on a turn mark), the estimator's spring-shaped cycle bar, the price/review rows hung on turn ticks, and the footer reading 30/30 balanced.

palette.family: Garage Night Concrete + Sodium Driveway Lamp

layoutMoves: left margin column (72px desktop) carries the winding spring and turn marks through the page
pinned 5-panel repair story where each step rises like a door section
price sheet hung on turn-mark ticks with repair and new-door ranges side by side
light concrete band for the tools to break the dark run

motion.intro: 21:9 spring strip opens upward via clip-path inset from the bottom like a door rising (900ms) while the h1 line-masks in; counter rolls to 00
stories: wind: pinned repair story scrubs the margin spring and counts quarter turns 00 to 30, each step panel rises
draw: estimator spring bar fills used cycles and snaps a gap at end of life
motion.hover: lift: translateY(-3px) and the seam roller slides 8px right
